contexts.text: The word in the Original Language for stores, also means arsenals, and also treasuries, which, in the inward sense, have almost the same signification... Arsenals are where the arms of war are stored up, by which are signified such things as are of truth fighting against falsity, and in the opposite sense, of falsity fighting against truths... Thus by cities of stores, or of arsenals, or of treasuries are signified in general doctrines from falsified truths.
